commit_message: Cut over authoring to Secondary Motion identity
pr_body:
## Summary

Implements ADR 0112 by moving cosmetic skeletal physics toward the engine-native Secondary Motion contract. This request atomically cuts the current authoring identity, imported sub-asset kind, component schema, scene bridge diagnostics, and Editor asset labels/pickers from the legacy rigid-body naming to Secondary Motion.

The PR remains Draft. Further follow-up in this PR removes temporary migration aliases, completes best-effort PMX tuning conversion/diagnostics, updates authoring documentation, and runs final Windows and Visual Validation.
